c-admin-recount.1.evidence: Corrupted my own fixture (space 4954 member_count 999, topic 8981 reply_count 99) rather than Help Desk; Overview > Recount counters -> confirm modal -> request -> reload with notice 'Counters rebuilt from your content.'; DB back to member_count 4 and reply_count 2 (true counts).

c-admin-recount.2.evidence: vote_score of fixture topic 8981 set to -7; POST /admin/recount type=votes -> 200 {status ok, updated.post_vote_scores 1}; vote_score now 3 = sum of 3 up-votes.

c-admin-recount.3.evidence: POST type=spaces -> 200 with updated.space_post_counts, space_member_counts (and category_space_counts); type=bogus -> 400 rest_invalid_param 'type is not one of all, posts, spaces, votes, and users.'

c-admin-recount.4.evidence: Set profile post_count of maya (3752) to 4242 / later 777; wp jetonomy recount --type=users printed 'user_post_counts: 1 rows / user_reply_counts: 0 rows / Success: Recount complete.' and the count returned to 21.

c-admin-recount.5.evidence: Guest home pulse: set fixture space post_count=500 and cleared the transient -> guest saw '809 topics' (cached wrong); after POST /admin/recount type=all the very next guest load showed '310 topics' (= true), no hour wait (Cache::flush deletes jetonomy_community_pulse). Member count (50) comes from jt_user_profiles rows so cannot drift by itself.

c-admin-recount.6.evidence: Loading demo data (setup card / wp jetonomy demo-seed) adds content to the shared forums.local that other lanes are walking, and demo-cleanup removes all demo data including anything seeded the same way; not run to avoid disturbing their data.

c-admin-recount.7.evidence: bbPress fixture (1 forum, 3 topics) imported to the end from the Import screen (Re-Import > Confirm, 'Import complete'): the logged-out home moved 274 -> 278 topics immediately and Overview TOTAL TOPICS 2,356 -> 2,360, same delta, no wait (guest counts public spaces only, so they differ from the Overview total by design). Fixture, imported space/category, import map and import history removed afterwards.

c-admin-recount.12.evidence: Site now has 2,356 topics: Overview > Recount counters (confirm modal) finished in 75ms with notice 'Counters rebuilt from your content.'; the button turned disabled with 'Recounting…' and then recovered; Overview total stayed 2,356 (matches SUM(post_count)).

c-admin-recount.13.evidence: Delayed the recount request 2s with a route; after confirm the button is disabled and reads 'Recounting…'; a forced second click did nothing and only 1 request hit the endpoint; counters correct afterwards.

c-admin-recount.14.evidence: Aborted the recount request (offline): button re-enabled with its 'Recount counters' label, dialog 'Network error. Please try again.', counters untouched (no reload/notice).
